# Marvo Tech Lab

> Marvo Tech Lab is a freelance digital services brand led by Adebayo Daniel, building premium websites, SEO systems, and AI automation for small and growing businesses.

Marvo Tech Lab offers web design and development, on-page SEO, GEO/AEO (AI search) optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, sales funnel design, ad campaign setup, and AI automation systems.

## Services
- Web design and development
- On-page SEO
- GEO/AEO optimization for AI search engines and LLMs
- Google Business Profile optimization
- Sales funnel design
- Ad campaign setup
- AI automation systems

## Selected Projects
- Logistics website and freight enquiry system
- Vehicle dealership inventory and quote system
- Solar energy business website
